narration.text: And Noah builded an altar unto the Lord; and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
Before building a house, before planting a field, Noah built an altar. The first thing he did on the new earth was say thank you.

And the Lord smelled a sweet savour; and the Lord said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake; for the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.
And God answered with a promise. He knew the human heart was still broken. He chose mercy anyway.
